notes: A held ExpressKey shortcut no longer stays down after the pen leaves range
Buttons can send F13 through F19 or open MockTab's settings
Pen clicks and window activation should work on macOS 27.2
Presses no longer stick on small tablets with large displays
An Art Pen on Intuos4 and Intuos5-era tablets updates twice as often
The Cintiq 22HD's three top keys work
The Cintiq 24HD Touch pen works again alongside touch
MockTab can download and install updates
Buttons open apps, files, and links dragged onto their rows, and run Keyboard Maestro macros
The Info pane shows live input as gauges
Internal links open settings panes and Help sections
MobileStudio Pro keys, rocker, and ring gain device support, but require verification
A resting pen holds the pointer steady on older tablets
Intuos4 key displays go dark at quit
Art Pen rotation no longer stands in for tilt, since Photoshop reads rotation directly
